card.name: Hyphens and brackets inside chemical names
card.fires_on: Punctuation or spaces (hyphen, open parenthesis, space) that come just before a number or part of a substituent in a systematic chemical name. It fires where a numbered locant such as 5-, 6- or 8- is followed by more name.

modes.label: Hyphen or parenthesis after a locant
modes.description: The joining mark after a position number in a chemical name, where a substituent group follows.

modes.label: Hyphen in acetyl or bromo names
modes.description: The hyphen between a prefix such as N-acetyl or bromo and the numbered core compound.

modes.label: Space before numbered compound in titles
modes.description: A space or the word of just before a numbered chemical name in a paper title or drug list.

card.writes: It promotes substitution words such as substituted and bis, which fits predicting more structure in a systematic chemical name.
card.plain: It marks the joining points inside long chemical names where a numbered side group comes next.
